github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, chore, build, ci.
Summary must be imperative, present tense, 72 characters or fewer, and with no trailing period.
Include a scope when appropriate (e.g., api, models, controllers, ui, pwa, docker, tests, auth).
Do not include commit bodies unless explicitly asked.
Commit messages must reflect PetCare Companion architecture and standards from AGENTS.md.
Ensure atomic commits without hard-coded secrets or credentials.
Align with educational and demonstrative intent, keeping container memory minimal.

github.copilot.chat.pullRequestDescripti.text: PR title must be a single line, imperative voice, and may use Conventional Commit style.
Include sections: Summary, Changes, Files / Areas Touched, Verification, Checklist.
Checklist must include: PSR-12 compliance, Laravel best practices, documentation updates, no architecture drift, consistency with AGENTS.md, tests pass, Docker commands used for Laravel operations.
Descriptions must be concise and aligned with PetCare Companion's educational constraints and Dockerized workflows.
Ensure branch naming follows feature/*, fix/*, docs/* convention.
Highlight any changes to MVC layers, Sanctum auth, Stripe integration, or gift economy features.

github.copilot.chat.reviewSelection.inst.text: Check code against PSR-12, Laravel best practices, and AGENTS.md guidelines.
Flag banned patterns: hard-coded secrets, third-party packages without instruction, architectural drift from MVC/service layer, no environment variables for configs.
Ensure validation in Form Requests, business logic in services, proper Eloquent relationships and policies.
Verify atomic commits, branch naming (feature/*, fix/*, docs/*), and PR checklist compliance.
Check for proper Sanctum CSRF/auth, Stripe webhook security, and gift economy credit handling.
Provide specific actionable improvements, not broad rewrites, focusing on maintainability and educational value.
